[[File:UmbaraHighway-DOU.png|thumb|right|250px|The main road leading to the Umbara capital city]]
This '''main road''' led to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara's]] [[Umbaran capital city/Legends|capital city]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|invaded]] Umbara and used this highway to advance to the [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. However, [[Umbaran soldier/Legends|Umbaran Soldiers]] had [[Mine/Legends|mined]] the street and the Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] suffered some casualties when some troopers stepped on such mines.
